prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit on a production sprite atlas. Preserve the exact 1024x1536 canvas, flat green background, exact 4-column by 8-row grid, character scale, all cell anchors, lighting, painted top-down dark-fantasy ARPG style, and every pixel of the other 24 cells as closely as possible. Edit ONLY the lower body from the hips downward in the SECOND COLUMN (column index 1) of each of the 8 rows. Those 8 second-column cells are the dedicated idle poses. In every edited cell, keep the exact authored viewing direction and keep the head, neck, torso, shoulders, arms, hands, pelvis height, body center, and ground position unchanged. Replace the walking/mid-stride legs with a clearly stationary balanced human stance: both knees relaxed but nearly straight, both feet flat and visibly planted on the same ground baseline, feet only shoulder-width apart with no leg far forward or far behind, weight centered between both legs, no lifted heel, no raised trailing foot, no running or walking silhouette. Preserve the fitted charcoal neutral under-suit and bare head. Do not add or remove any character, weapon, shield, armor, helmet, boot, cape, shadow, grid line, label, or text. Make no changes above the hips and no changes in columns 0, 2, or 3.
